subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Postponement Strategy
description: A micro-lesson that makes Postponement Strategy usable.

hook.text: Benetton dyes sweaters after orders come in, not before. They hold colorless sweaters and dye on demand.

buildup.text: Postponement delays final product customization until actual demand is known—reducing forecast risk.

discovery.text: Holding generic inventory and customizing late means fewer SKUs to forecast and less obsolete stock.

twist.text: Postponement requires products designed for late customization. Not every product can be postponed.

climax.text: Dell built a billion-dollar business on postponement: assembling PCs only after the customer orders.

punchline.text: Don't decide too early. Wait for the order, then customize.

quiz.question: What does postponement delay?
options: Final product customization until demand is known
